Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Part Time Visiting Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the GAIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Part-Time Visiting Medical Consultant – MD (Medicine).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Part-Time Visiting Medical Consultant – MD (Medicine) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 3500 Per Hour.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Part-Time Visiting Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is MD (Medicine) from a recognized University/Institution, with valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The date of the walk-in interview is 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the GAIL office located for the walk-in?
faq.answer: The GAIL office is located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, with a pincode of 462026.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and registration certificates.
